topography.project_purpose: cBridge is a cross-chain asset bridge that enables fast, low-cost transfers of tokens across multiple blockchains. It uses a network of relay nodes and liquidity pools to facilitate seamless interoperability between supported chains.
topography.relationship_narrative: The cBridge family consists of a single product line where core bridge contracts (liquidity pools, relay nodes) are deployed across multiple chains and share a common architecture. Supporting contracts include token adapters and access control modules that facilitate asset transfers and governance across the bridge network.
